periods.summary: Ikki deduces that Amane's power is not future prediction but wish-granting causality/luck manipulation, and rejects Amane's offer to give him the Seven Stars championship.
periods.cause: Kiriko's impossible hospital-wide emergency follows Amane's claim that he will not fight her, and Ikki connects it to Amane's past uncanny predictions and Utakata's defeat.
periods.process: Ikki reasons that Amane did not predict events; rather, events were arranged after he wished for outcomes such as meeting Ikki, attacking Hagun smoothly, avoiding fights, or detecting Alice's betrayal. Amane confirms the name Excessive Goddess's Favor but claims he only wishes and cannot choose the method. He then offers to wish Ikki into becoming champion as an apology.
periods.outcome: Ikki pushes Amane away and states clearly that he hates him, because the offer would steal the meaning of Ikki's effort and his promise with Stella.
periods.aftermath: Amane promises not to help if Ikki hates it, but reveals he truly wants to watch Ikki struggle, bleed and break against fate. Ikki recognizes deep malice and fear behind Amane's smile.
periods.significance: Defines Amane as one of the volume's central threats and clarifies why ordinary tactics or tournament rules struggle to address him.
